description: This file defines the Indirect class which provides functionality to interpret and evaluate the Excel INDIRECT function, parsing cell references, ranges, and handling related address conversions and validations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Indirect
classes.description: Provides static methods to evaluate the INDIRECT Excel function, converting text references into cell or range references within the spreadsheet, with address validation and range handling.

methods.name: a1Format
methods.description: Determines if the cell address is in A1 or R1C1 format based on the provided format indicator.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Converts the cell address to a validated string, ensuring it is not null or empty.

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Main method that returns the referenced cell or range based on a text string, handling address parsing, formula evaluation, and error management.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Extracts cell values from the specified range within a worksheet, returning either an array of values or a single value.

methods.name: handleRowColumnRanges
methods.description: Adjusts cell range references based on row or column ranges within a worksheet.
